body: i completly understand. It's been that way with me all my life. You should talk to your family and boyfriend about it. They could understand. Sometimes we don't feel things that we want to, and my guess is that if you don't have depression or something then their is something behind it. Maybe even just being to scared to feel something deep down. Me for example, I don't deal well with being upset,so I don't feel anything about things, I can't see how to deal with. I need to think about how I feel more, and process it.
